businessModel: Free; monetisation not documented (sells itself as ad-free)
updateCadence: Frequent Play updates; Chromium may lag Chrome by several majors
summary: Chromium-based Android browser that installs extensions from the Chrome Web Store and Edge Add-ons, blocks ads and trackers by default, and adds a video downloader and biometric Data Vault. Proprietary; Chromium base lags upstream.
bestFor: Android users wanting Chrome extensions on mobile
People who want ads blocked out of the box
notFor: People who need open-source code to audit
Users who need the freshest Chromium patches
Anyone avoiding vendors with unclear ownership

pros.title: Desktop extensions
pros.detail: Installs from the Chrome Web Store and Microsoft Edge Add-ons.

pros.title: Blocking on by default
pros.detail: Play listing: ad and tracker blocking enabled by default.

pros.title: Fingerprint protection
pros.detail: Listed on the Play store alongside private mode and a biometric Data Vault.

cons.title: Closed source
cons.detail: No audit; you must trust Quetta Networks.

cons.title: Chromium lag
cons.detail: The Aug 7, 2026 release used Chromium 148 while Chrome was several versions ahead.

cons.title: Extension quirks
cons.detail: Quetta's own blog warns desktop extensions may not behave well on a phone.

cons.title: Unclear ownership and privacy claims
cons.detail: Play listing says no data shared with third parties; stronger "zero collection" claims are third-party.

faq.a: Quetta lists it as a popular extension, but Chrome Web Store dropped MV2 on Aug 31, 2026, so full uBO availability is unverified.
